rows.a-clone-copies-the-copy-ability-the-shap: CR 707.9a: the Shapeshifter's copiable values include the copy trigger it gave itself when it copied the Elves, so a Clone copying the Shapeshifter should copy that trigger too and become a copy of the next creature. Observed: the Shapeshifter kept no copy trigger after copying the Elves, the Clone copying it stayed a 1/1 Elf Druid, and the later Grizzly Bears did not change it.
